summary: This directory manages the core business logic and state transitions for the application. It acts as the central orchestrator for processing domain events, maintaining entity consistency, and enforcing business rules across the system.
responsibilities: Execute core domain logic and business workflows
Orchestrate transitions between internal application states
Enforce invariant validation and business rules
relationships: Domain models provide the state that business logic operates upon.
Business logic enforces rules during state transitions to ensure entity consistency.
State transitions reflect the lifecycle of domain entities as governed by business requirements.
designDecisions: Separation of domain logic from infrastructure concerns
Encapsulation of state transition logic within domain services
Use of validation layers to enforce business invariants
Immutable state updates to ensure predictability
